intro: Comparing a personal message with a booking confirmation and finding dates, times and conditions.
p.entradas.consejo: They are bought for the theatre, cinema or a museum. The singular is «entrada».
p.función.consejo: It has an accent on the ó: fun-THYÓN. You say «la función empieza a las siete».
p.quedamos.consejo: Here «quedar» means to arrange a meeting: «¿quedamos a las siete?».
p.mándame.consejo: It is «manda» + «me». The accent keeps the stress on MAN: MÁN-da-me.
p.a tiempo.consejo: You say «llegar a tiempo». It means without delay.
p.confirmar.consejo: A booking is confirmed by email or phone. It comes from Latin, like «firme».
p.reserva.consejo: It works for a hotel, train or restaurant. The v sounds b.
p.localizador.consejo: It is a code of letters and numbers. It comes from «localizar», meaning to find.
p.fecha.consejo: In Spanish you say «el 18 de julio». Months are lowercase.
p.desayuno.consejo: At a hotel it can be included in the price or paid separately.
p.responda.consejo: Formal emails use it: «responda a este correo antes del 10 de julio».
p.cambio.consejo: It is also the money returned when you pay: «¿tiene cambio?».
b1.texto:
Routine messages state their purpose in the first line. Look for **names**, **dates**, **times** and what the reader has to **do**.

- Date: **el sábado 18**; **del 18 al 20 de julio**.
- Time: **a las siete y media**; **a las siete**.
- Condition: **antes del 10 de julio**.

A confirmation says what is booked, but sometimes does not explain every cancellation condition: look for a separate policy if the text mentions one. The texts in this lesson are invented examples.
b2.f0.texto: I already have the tickets for Saturday.
b2.f1.texto: What time does the show start?
b2.f2.texto: It starts at half past seven.
b2.f3.texto: Shall we meet in front of the theatre at seven?
b2.f5.texto: I will wait for you inside the theatre.
b2.f6.texto: Thank you very much for the tickets.
b4.texto:
For dates and times:

- **el sábado 18**, **el 18 de julio**, **del 18 al 20 de julio**.
- **a las siete**, **a las siete y media**, **a las siete menos cinco**.
- **antes del 10 de julio** marks the last day to act.

A formal confirmation uses **nosotros**: **Confirmamos** la reserva. And asks for something with **usted**: **Responda** a este correo.

A personal message uses **tú**: **Mándame** un mensaje, **te espero** dentro.
b4.e0.texto: We confirm the booking of a double room.
b4.e1.texto: Reply to this email before 10 July.
b4.e2.texto: The show starts at half past seven.
b5.f0.texto: A warm light falls on the front of the theatre.
b5.f1.texto: Lucía waits next to the door with the tickets in her hand.
b5.f2.texto: People arrive in small groups and speak in low voices.
b5.f3.texto: A smell of popcorn floats among the coats.
b5.f4.texto: The clock in the square shows five to seven.
b5.f5.texto: Marta appears running through the crowd with wet hair.
b5.f6.texto: Lucía raises her hand and smiles with relief.
b5.f7.texto: The two friends go through the door and show the tickets.
b5.f8.texto: The red curtains wait in silence inside the hall.
b5.f9.texto: The show begins at half past seven with applause.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! Lucía says so in the dialogue.
b6.o1.refuerzo: At seven is when they meet, not when it starts.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Nobody says eight in the dialogue.
b6.pregunta: What time does the show start?
b7.o0.refuerzo: Well done! It means it is already in the price.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Adjunto» is used with documents in an email.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Cancelled would say there is no breakfast.
b8.frase: Confirmamos la reserva para dos noches
b8.traduccion: We confirm the booking for two nights
b9.o0.refuerzo: Exactly! «Antes de» marks the last moment.
b9.o1.refuerzo: After would be too late; the deadline would have passed.
b9.o2.refuerzo: The twentieth is the hotel checkout, not the deadline.
b9.pregunta: The email says «antes del 10 de julio». When do you reply?
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «We confirm the booking».
b11.frase: ¿____ delante del teatro a las siete?
b11.o0.refuerzo: Well done! «Quedamos» proposes a meeting between us.
b11.o1.refuerzo: «Quedan» is about them; you mean us.
b11.pregunta: Suggest a plan to your friend.
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes! It helps find your booking.
b12.o1.refuerzo: The entrada is something else: it is the ticket.
b12.o2.refuerzo: The double room is what is booked, not the code.
p.confirmamos.consejo: From «confirmar». The stress is on MA.
p.julio.consejo: The j sounds like h. The stress is on HU.
p.grupos.consejo: Plural of «grupo». The stress is on GRU.
p.palomitas.consejo: Plural of «palomita», a small popped grain. The stress is on MI.
p.abrigos.consejo: Plural of «abrigo». The g before i sounds hard.
p.corriendo.consejo: Gerund of «correr», to run. The rr is strong in the middle.
p.multitud.consejo: The stress is on TI. The d at the end sounds soft.
p.enseñan.consejo: From «enseñar», to show or teach. The ñ sounds like «ny».
p.aplauso.consejo: The au is one diphthong. The stress is on PLAU.
p.código.consejo: The stress is on KO. The g before o sounds hard.
